## Definition of Ready Checklist

All stories in sprint backlog must meet these criteria:
- [ ] User story clearly defined with acceptance criteria
- [ ] Story sized and estimated by team
- [ ] Dependencies identified and resolved
- [ ] Design mockups available (if UI work)
- [ ] API contracts defined (if backend work)
- [ ] Test strategy discussed

## Definition of Done Reminder

Stories are only complete when they meet all DoD criteria:
- [ ] Code implemented and tested
- [ ] Unit tests written (≥85% coverage)
- [ ] Integration tests passing
- [ ] Code reviewed and approved
- [ ] QA testing completed
- [ ] Documentation updated
- [ ] Acceptance criteria validated
